title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas formulation and report equations are present.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS read, geometry and cell-face graph code are present.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face accumulation plus global norm reduction is implemented.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov is the actual interior-face flux. Roe implementation exists but solver.cpp calls Rusanov; metadata claiming Roe/Harten-Yee is inaccurate.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip branches plus boundary-value output semantics are implemented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Green-Gauss linear reconstruction is active after startup; partition-face fallback is disclosed.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen and density/pressure fallback paths are present.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier code exists, but underdeveloped steady laminar results limit validation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS-like pseudo-time path exists, yet currentCFL is forced to at least 10 and 2,000-step finals do not meet supplied steady controls.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: True BDF2 outer/inner source structure exists and results reach t=300, but ten fixed inner iterations and final ratio 0.156 miss requested 0.001.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS PartGraphKway, point-to-point halos and global reductions are directly evidenced; np8 artifacts exist.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
